## Public Documentation Search Results

| Point | Finding | Source | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. `M207 P` and `M208 P` units under `G21` | `UM10720` shows inch values (`P0.15`, `P0.08`) only. It does not mention `G21` or millimeters for `M207` or `M208`. `TD10365` states `"G64 must be specified in inch units, not metric"`. Neither `TD10365` nor the M-code reference states units for `M207` or `M208`. | `UM10720: 1300PL Plasma Table Operator's Manual` (§6.3.1, §7.2, https://tormach.com/media/asset/u/m/um10720_1300pl_0722a_web.pdf); `TD10365: PathPilot Post Processor Guidelines` (https://tormach.com/pathpilot-post-processor-guidelines); `Supported CNC M-Codes Reference for PathPilot` (https://tormach.com/supported-cnc-m-codes-reference-for-pathpilot) | Not found |
| 2. `M207`, `M208`, and `M209` after `M200` override AutoFS | `UM10720` (§7.2) marks `M207`, `M208`, and `M209` as set by `M200`. §6.3.1 presents `M200` as an alternative to the manual block (`M210`, `M211`, `M207`, `M208`, `M209`, `F`). A public 1300PL shop guide reports that feed, cut height, and dwell commands after `M200` override AutoFS: `"This overrides the settings of the AutoFS stock picker in Pathpilot."` That guide does not name `M207` by code number. | `UM10720` (§6.3.1, §7.2); `Tormach CNC Plasma Cutter Debugging` (https://wiki.pumpingstationone.org/Tormach_CNC_Plasma_Cutter_Debugging) | Stated in the source |
| 3. Feedless `G1` moves after `M200` use AutoFS feed | `UM10720` (§7.2) states for `M200`: `"AutoFS will set feedrate, THC voltage, and pierce delay"`. The §6.2.1 program sets `G90`, `G64`, `G17`, `G54`, `T1 M6 G43 H1`, `G30`, then `G0 X0 Y0`. It then runs `M200`, `G15`, `G16`, `G1 X0 Y4`, `M205`, and `G30` with no `F` word. §6.2.2 confirms `M200` sets the feedrate for `G1`. | `UM10720` (§6.2.1, §6.2.2, §7.2, https://tormach.com/media/asset/u/m/um10720_1300pl_0722a_web.pdf) | Stated in the source; seen in an example program |
| 4. `G41.1 D<kerf>` offsets to the waste side | Tormach G-code docs and LinuxCNC docs state that `G41.1` offsets left and `G42.1` offsets right. `D` sets the full kerf diameter. `TD10365` mistakenly prints left side under `G42.1`, while the G-code reference and LinuxCNC confirm `G41.1` is left. In `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-plasma/plasma_plate_with_holes_control.nc`, outer contours run clockwise and holes run counter-clockwise. `G41.1` offsets left onto the waste side on both. Entry needs a straight `G1` lead longer than `D/2`. | `Supported CNC G-Codes Reference for PathPilot` (https://tormach.com/supported-cnc-g-codes-reference-for-pathpilot); `TD10365: PathPilot Post Processor Guidelines` (https://tormach.com/pathpilot-post-processor-guidelines); `LinuxCNC G Code Overview` (§G41.1, G42.1, https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/g-code.html) | Stated in the source |

## Not found

- **`M207 P` and `M208 P` units under `G21`**: Public Tormach manuals, post guidelines, and PathPilot release notes (`SB0046`) do not state `M207` or `M208` units under `G21`. They do not confirm whether PathPilot reads `M207 P` and `M208 P` in millimeters or inches.
- **`M207` override by name after `M200`**: Public user notes confirm that commands after `M200` override AutoFS for feed, cut height, and dwell. They do not confirm `M207` pierce height or `M209` pierce delay by code number.
- **`M207` Z-axis load warning**: Public Tormach documents do not describe the load warning for `M207` on the Z axis. `UM10720` (§7.1) states that `G15` sets work Z0 on the plate before `G16` lifts to pierce height.

## Suggested changes (no code)

- **`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` (`M207` and `M208` under `G21`)**: Do not change `fu(v)` on `M207` and `M208` yet. First run a `G21` test with `M207` and `M208` on PathPilot to check whether `P` reads millimeters or inches. If PathPilot reads inches under `G21`, convert `M207` and `M208` values to inches. Then update `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-plasma/plasma_plate_with_holes_mm.nc`.
- **`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` (`M200` with `M207`, `M208`, and `M209`)**: Keep `M200` before optional `M207`, `M208`, and `M209` words because `M200` supplies THC voltage and amperage. Check on PathPilot that `M207` and `M209` override AutoFS without unwanted dwell.
- **`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` (feedless `G1` after `M200`)**: Keep omitting `F` on `G1`, `G2`, and `G3` when AutoFS feed is active. `UM10720` confirms that `M200` sets the feedrate.
- **`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` (`G41.1` and `G42.1`)**: Keep `G41.1` for left compensation and `G42.1` for right compensation. Measure a `G41.1` test cut on PathPilot to confirm the offset side.
- **`assets/machines/tormach-1300pl.mch`**: `assets/machines/tormach-1300pl.mch` needs no change from these public documents.
- **`site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md`**: Add the `M207` Z-axis load warning note to `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md` after a real control check. Confirm why the warning appears and that `G15` clears it safely.

A check on a real control is still needed before cutting.

blocked: requires a clean-room PathPilot v2.14.4 Hub (`1300PL SIM`) or physical 1300PL machine check to settle `M207`/`M208` units under `G21` and verify the remaining runtime items before editing G-code output or guide text.

Checked `upstream/main` at `31f8d03d` and open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` still emits `M207 P` and `M208 P` in active program units (`fu(...)`), so `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-plasma/plasma_plate_with_holes_mm.nc` writes `M207 P3.8` under `G21`.
- No open PR touches any plasma file.
- As recorded in the earlier public documentation check above, `UM10720`, `TD10365`, the PathPilot M-code reference, and `SB0046` do not confirm whether PathPilot reads `M207 P` and `M208 P` in millimeters or inches under `G21` (nor verify `M207`/`M209` runtime override of `M200` or the `M207` Z-max load warning). Changing `tormach-plasma.cps` without a control check risks a 25.4x pierce/cut height error.
- This headless session has no browser tool, no physical 1300PL, and no authenticated PathPilot Hub session (`hub.pathpilot.com` requires login, and worker rules forbid entering tokens/passwords; unsandboxed `curl` to `tormach.com` was also blocked by permission check).

Notes for resuming once a Hub or machine run settles the four checks:

- `site/content/guide/operations-plasma.md` moved to `site/content/guide/operations/operations-plasma.md` in PR #1903.
- Under `AGENTS.md` ("Safety floor"), if `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` changes posted G-code, this issue should carry at least `effort:high` rather than `effort:low`.

Stopped before claiming (`#1872` left open, not claimed, no branch/worktree/PR created). Drop `blocked` once the PathPilot `1300PL` / Hub test results are recorded.
